summary: Verified the _merge_year_responses fix for Impact Assessments & Projects (BRSR Environment, P_IMPACT). Login with goyalsomil2001@gmail.com -> Environment -> BRSR Framework tab -> Impact Assessments & Projects sub-tab -> Edit Mode -> filled R&D (current_fy=12345, previous_fy=6789) and Capex (current_fy=54321, previous_fy=9876) on the 'What percentage of R&D and Capex investments...' question -> Save Responses (PUT 200) -> full page reload -> values persist and display correctly in both View Mode (table shows 12345/6789 for R&D, 54321/9876 for Capex) and Edit Mode (inputs prefilled). The /multi-year GET response now returns the correct shape: env_sustainable_rd_capex.rd = {current_fy, previous_fy} and env_sustainable_rd_capex.capex = {current_fy, previous_fy} with NO double suffix (no current_fy_current_fy). BUG FIX VERIFIED.

issues: After saving R&D/Capex, the progress badge still shows '0/6 answered (0%)' instead of reflecting the newly saved question. Likely a separate progress-counter calculation issue, not related to the merge fix being tested.

action_items: Optional: Investigate why progress badge does not increment after saving the R&D/Capex question (separate from this bug fix).
critical_code_review_comments: service.py _merge_year_responses now correctly handles three cases: exact 'current_fy'/'previous_fy' keys (copy as-is), already-suffixed keys (copy as-is), and unsuffixed keys (add suffix). Logic looks correct and is verified by API output.

Inputs in the R&D/Capex table lack data-testid attributes - all 6 inputs are unnamed type=number with no testid; harder to target reliably in tests. Recommend adding data-testid like 'rd-current-fy-input', 'capex-previous-fy-input', etc.
seed_data_creation: Persisted env_sustainable_rd_capex for org 9067d872-8a3a-4ed9-8494-e3ef04952f7c reporting_year 2026-27: rd={current_fy:12345, previous_fy:6789}, capex={current_fy:54321, previous_fy:9876}. Data remains in DB for visual verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BRSR Environment Impact Assessments tab works. Path: Environment page -> click 'BRSR Framework' tab (top tabs) -> click 'Impact Assessments & Projects' sub-tab -> click Edit Mode button -> inputs become editable -> 'Save Responses' button at bottom-right triggers PUT /api/esg-questionnaire/responses/BRSR/environment/{year}. Multi-year GET endpoint /api/esg-questionnaire/responses/BRSR/environment/{year}/multi-year returns merged data with correct current_fy/previous_fy keys (no double suffixing).
rca of the issue: Root cause was in _merge_year_responses in /app/backend/modules/esg_questionnaire/service.py: when iterating column keys in nested dicts (e.g. env_sustainable_rd_capex.rd = {current_fy: '12345', previous_fy: '6789'}), the code unconditionally appended '_current_fy' or '_previous_fy' suffix to every key, producing 'current_fy_current_fy' and 'previous_fy_previous_fy' which the frontend could not match to its field bindings. Fix correctly checks `if col_key in ('current_fy', 'previous_fy')` and copies the value as-is. Verified by: PUT saves {rd: {current_fy:'12345', previous_fy:'6789'}} -> GET /multi-year returns the same shape -> frontend renders 12345 and 6789 in correct columns after reload.
